owner_decisions: AM-0021 is additive after AM-0020 and preserves every non-conflicting prior requirement.
Premium main is an event-driven semantic owner; deterministic engine owns routine orchestration.
Main context and token economy are priorities and SLOs, not completion blockers.
Correctness and execution continuity override token targets without requiring owner approval.
Main does not ingest raw child JSONL, full logs, full ledger or repeated full-plan text by default.
Main receives signed capsules and ordered deltas, with exact drill-down to plan, diff and evidence.
No automatic main-model downgrade is authorized merely to save tokens.
Codex, Claude Code and OpenCode are the primary context/wake adapter targets.
The latest concepts may be dogfooded before full installation only with honest preview-enforcement labels.
Machine-wide native-child target is 8 normal and 10 burst when conflict-free work and resources permit.
Before global broker certification the 8–10 ceiling is shared across agent-rules, pos-ops and mini-toeic.score.
Dirty external project candidates must be content-addressedly frozen before branch/worktree fan-out.

known_gaps: supervisor defaults remain two writers and one reviewer
resource broker is not global across host processes
branch integration does not fully enforce owned-path and semantic leases
native throughput evidence is partly synthetic
latest ledger, CI and host attestations do not bind captured HEAD

activation_rule: At the next safe checkpoint, preserve all in-flight candidate work, verify immutable hashes, activate AM-0021 after ledger-effective AM-0020 through the canonical atomic lifecycle API, recompute effective identity, stale affected review/terminal eligibility, regenerate shadows, retain NEEDS_REMEDIATION, then implement and dogfood M11-R37 through M11-R50 without stopping independent READY work.
